Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zlib
data = open('testcase.pdf','rb').read()
idx = data.find(b'14 0 obj')
start = data.find(b'stream', idx) + len(b'stream')
if data[start:start+2] == b'\r\n':
    start += 2
elif data[start:start+1] in (b'\n', b'\r'):
    start += 1
# take all data to end of file
comp = data[start:]
print('comp len', len(comp))
d = zlib.decompressobj()
try:
    font = d.decompress(comp)
    print('decompressed', len(font))
    open('font.bin','wb').write(font)
    print(font[:16])
except Exception as e:
    print('err', e)
    print('unconsumed', len(d.unconsumed_tail))
"
